the Connections card renders the envelope's status and bounds from the daemon record (bounded vs unbounded is daemon truth, never a client-side number)

SILENT WITHIN POLICY: the run never parks on an approval card — its execution was drawn against the attach-time standing envelope (posture silent_within_policy on the run's authority record)
Work / Sessions shows NO approval card for the silent run
the silently authorized run completes on the qualified harness/model and writes at least one file (0s)
the silence is attributable: a standing_draw receipt (operation session_execute, envelope hash, admission intent) is on the run's session — the draw-down receipt exists, no dialog was suppressed
OVER THE ENVELOPE: a second run under the same 1-usage envelope fails CLOSED and typed (refused_outside_envelope / max_usages), nothing ran, no card, and the refusal receipt names the bound
REVOCATION: revoking the envelope on Connections refuses the very next session naming that connection (412, lease_status revoked) — leaving is real
the written artifacts of the silently authorized run are in the session's workspace on disk
the session record carries the execute receipt binding the consumed capability lease — the standing draw is the lease's admission
cost/consumption, the run timeline and the work ledger answer for the operator
